checks.name: structure-unchanged-provider-preflight
argv:
import json,subprocess
def strip(o):
  if isinstance(o, dict): return {k: strip(v) for k, v in o.items() if k != 'description'}
  if isinstance(o, list): return [strip(v) for v in o]
  return o
after = strip(json.load(open('contracts/schemas/provider-preflight.json')))
before = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['git','show','be1b706:contracts/schemas/provider-preflight.json']))
assert after == before, 'structure changed'
print('structurally identical')

Only limits, limits.max_total_cost_usd, and approval gained a description annotation, which internal/contracts/validator.go's restricted keyword subset ignores.
